name: Liquid Sprays for Energy Sector and Industrial Applications
description: Introduction to liquid spray systems and their relevance in the energy and other industrial sectors; steady and unsteady sprays; statistical measures used in sprays; internal nozzle flows and interfacial disturbances leading to spray breakup; stability analysis; primary and secondary atomization; experimental spray diagnostics, spray modeling approaches; design of injectors for spray applications; durability of injectors; applications of sprays in heat engines, after-treatment devices, industrial burners, textile industry, carbon capture, photovoltaic cell (fabrication, cooling), gas enrichment, coating and mixing process in the industries, agriculture, hospitals etc.
